newsitem.title: USA: CBOT wheat seen 1-2 cents up on weather, spillover.
newsitem.headline: CBOT wheat seen 1-2 cents up on weather, spillover.

text.p: CBOT wheat futures were called to open one to two cents per bushel higher on rainy forecasts and spillover strength from Thursday's close, traders said.
Rains forecast for some U.S. Southern Plains states were expected to slow harvest, while rain in the eastern Corn Belt prompted soft red wheat quality concerns, traders said.
Additional support could stem from reports of freeze damage and lower yields in wheat that is being harvested in southern Oklahoma, traders said.
Some traders said hedge pressure tied to the ongoing hard red winter wheat harvest would limit advances.
